text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is in full swing. Looking
for praise,
Mayano Top Gun throws
herself into our various
training methods.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Bragging that she has become strong
enough, she
claims she can excite me
even more than Narita
Brian does with
her running abilities.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In order to prove this, she decides to
take on the
Kikuka Sho, one of the
Triple Crown tour races
that Нарита Брайан
herself raced in.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
